title: SWAQUAD-24: QA BENCHMARK DATASET IN SWAHILI

bias_targets.methodology: Balancing gender representation in texts and generated questions to ensure content does not favor gender-specific roles or assumptions, and ensuring perspectives from both males and females are reflected.

Training annotators to scrutinize data for implicit biases, identifying, flagging, and removing examples that could reinforce stereotypes or propagate ethnic, cultural, or social biases during dataset creation.
Including text from a diverse variety of Swahili dialects (e.g., coastal, Kenyan, and Congolese Swahili) to avoid over-representing any single linguistic variant.
Curating content generated by individuals from diverse backgrounds to ensure adequate representation across different socioeconomic statuses and educational levels.
Striving to include content generated by individuals from diverse demographic backgrounds, specifically factoring in different age groups.
